text:
maya: quick flag  noticed mismatch in API ref for PATCH /models/{model_id}/settings. The schema shows a `safety` object with `blocklist`, but the example payload still uses `safety_blocklist` at top-level. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 includes the old example.

jonathan: ah thanks. which one is the source of truth now? openapi vs example?

lee: runtime moved to nested SafetySettings (safety.blocklist) in Q3. We left a compatibility shim that accepts flat keys, but docs should reflect the live contract (nested).

sam: OK action items: (A) update the example JSON in the API reference, (B) update SDK code snippets (Go/JS) in the docs, (C) add a short migration note + curl transform for older clients.

maya: I can update the example JSON and add the migration note. Also will run the docs builder locally; CI is failing with the linter.

doc-builder-bot: build failed: docs/api/models.yaml: schema-example-mismatch (error 1004). CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234

jonathan: Current Go snippet in docs shows: 
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  SafetyBlocklist: []string{"bad","worse"},
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
we need to switch to: 
```go
req := &UpdateModelSettings{
  Safety: &SafetySettings{
    Blocklist: []string{"bad","worse"},
  },
}
client.UpdateModel(ctx, modelID, req)
```
I'll open a small follow-up PR to change SDK snippets in the docs tree.

lee: JS snippet needs the same swap: `safety_blocklist` -> `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. Also audit curl and curl+jq examples.

sam: Draft migration blurb: "Deprecated: top-level `safety_blocklist` keys. As of 2024-09-01, send `safety: { blocklist: [...] }`. Compatibility shim will be available for ~30 days; please migrate clients." Add a quick jq/curl transform example.

maya: Proposed transform for the migration guide: 
```bash
# old payload: {"safety_blocklist": ["x"]}
# new payload: {"safety": {"blocklist": ["x"]}}
cat old.json | jq '{safety: {blocklist: .safety_blocklist}}' | curl -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/$ID/settings
```

doc-builder-bot: note: once the schema examples and snippets are aligned the linter error should clear. Also update openapi/examples/models/update-settings.json if present.

jonathan: owner assignments: @maya update API example + migration note (link PR here), @jonathan update docs snippets (PR linking), @lee confirm shim deprecation timeline and call out date in migration note, @sam add short changelog/deprecation entry. I'll add docs-review label to both PRs.

maya: I'll push my PR today and link back. Thanks! :thumbsup:
